title: Unreturned-Fob Forgiveness for Long Tenancies: Security Deposit Account
content:
**Term.** A long tenancy forgives unreturned fobs charged on a Security Deposit Account. The forgiven fobs are taken off the number of fobs charged:

- **1 fob** for a tenancy of at least 48 full months from the lease's move-in date to its move-out date;
- **0.5 of a fob** for a tenancy of at least 24 but fewer than 48 full months;
- **none** for a shorter tenancy.

The forgiven fobs come off before the fobs are multiplied by the per-fob charge. The corrected fob charge never falls below 0, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** The move-in date on the Apartment Home Lease, and the move-out date on the deposit account.

| Full months, move-in to move-out | Fobs forgiven |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 1 |
| 24 to 47 | 0.5 |
| 23 or fewer | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases (per-fob charge taken as 75.00 USD)

| Fobs charged before forgiveness | Tenancy | Fobs after forgiveness | Charge for the fobs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 50 months | 2 | 150.00 |
| 3 | 30 months | 2.5 | 187.50 |
| 3 | 20 months | 3 | 225.00 |
| 0 | 50 months | below 0 | 0.00, as the charge never falls below 0 |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** A tenancy from 1 August 2021 to 1 August 2023 is 24 full months and forgives 0.5 of a fob. One ending on 31 July 2023 is 23 full months and forgives none.
